name: user: Little Minions, Disciple of Varashta
notes: From legacy/Custom builds/Little Minions - Disciple of Varashta.md: Disciple of Varashta, exactly two combat buttons, every Skeleton, Companion, Wolf, Spectre and Wardbound Minions banned, Chaos Inoculation, pure Energy Shield above 4,500, Fire/Cold/Lightning 75% (CI covers Chaos). The doc's damage anchor 'Kelari's Deception' isn't in the current game data (checked: gem names containing Kelari are Kelari's Malediction and Kelari, the Tainted Sands), so the main skill is Kelari, the Tainted Sands, the Djinn whose command it was (SEARCH1's reading). No budget named: endgame gear, no divine cap. Its disabled weapon-set exploit was removed in 0.5.5.
